mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the past 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A one-month rise in the federal funds rate above 0.5% signals an imminent monetary tightening, which increases discount rates and compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises above 0.5% in the past month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises above 0.5% in the past month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is below 0.5% and the unemployment rate exceeds 7.0%, it indicates a recessionary environment with accommodative monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in prolonged economic weakness.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and UNRATE > 7.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in housing starts below 600.0 thousand units and a decline in retail sales below 340.0 million dollars signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 600.0 and RSAFS < 340.0 in the late-cycle expansion regime, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in employment (PAYEMS) above 130,000 thousand persons over the past 3 months signals strong labor market conditions, which supports corporate earnings growth and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS > 130,000, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 97.0 index points over the past month signals a weakening supply chain and economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 97.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the core inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 215.0 and the federal funds rate is below 0.2%, it indicates a high-inflation, low-rate environment that typically triggers monetary policy tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 215.0 and FEDFUNDS < 0.2%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 215.0), a sustained rise in core inflation above 216.0 over the past 3 months signals accelerating inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to anticipated monetary tightening.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 215.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
